scientific_integrity: The proof is finite-dimensional and exact. It reconstructs the one-step operator from the published involute formulas, uses the published convergence theorem only after showing that every vector in the shape space is realized by a genuine convex constant-width polygon, and derives the center formula by an exact affine-iteration identity. The supplied checker is only a sign/index sanity check, not the proof of generality.
scientific_limitations: The formula is specific to the Craizer--Martini Minkowski involute and depends on the associated symmetric polygon U. It does not identify the resulting central point with a classical center or give coefficients independent of U. A residual literature-indexing risk remains for an obscure later note containing the same translation-aware resolvent.
title: A finite linear solve for the central point of a constant-width polygon
